page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-16-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d server family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 126.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 7.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance is provisioned with dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing. While the primary storage configuration lists local storage size as none, the instance profile includes a local SSD. It does not include any GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a memory-to-vCPU ratio of nearly 1:8, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the 16 vCPUs deliver predictable execution times. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per vCPU allows organizations to run memory-bound applications without paying for unnecessary additional compute cores, optimizing resource allocation.

The c4d-highmem-16-lssd is suited for workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers, data analytics, and enterprise applications requiring a high memory-to-CPU ratio. It is also appropriate for medium-scale web serving and backend services that demand dedicated compute resources and substantial memory capacity.
